'''[[Novice]]''' is the first level of an initiate of the [[Aes Sedai]] order.

This index lists all individuals who have been enrolled in the [[Novice book]] at the [[White Tower]].  It does not, however, include those women who have advanced to the rank of [[Accepted]] or to full [[Aes Sedai]] sisterhood.  Some girls on this list are active novices, alive at the dawn of the [[Fourth Age]] following [[Tarmon Gai'don]].  Others are women who were once enrolled in the Novice book, but were either put out of the tower or ran away, while others are those who died as novices.
